title: "Etymology Shiny test"
output: html_notebook

#The idea
Try to load in a csv file of the etymology code, then use it to post with a searchable shiny app

#Getting packages in
```{r package-loading}
library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(babynames)
library(dplyr)
library(DT)
library(plotly)
library(d3wordcloud)
library(readr)
library(leaflet)
library(shinythemes)
```

#Getting dataset in
```{r datset-loading}
setwd("C:/Users/Mark.Williamson.2/Desktop/Williamson Data/R/R_data")

ET_db <- read.csv("Etymology_Database_Phylum_small.csv")
head(ET_db)
names(ET_db)
```

#Shiny Run
```{r go-fo}
ui <- fluidPage(
  "Hello, welcome to the test Etymology Database",
  dataTableOutput("table")
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  output$table <-
    renderDataTable({datatable(ET_db)})
}

shinyApp(ui=ui, server=server)

```
